WITH lab_with_patient AS (
  SELECT 
    p.SEX,
    CASE 
      WHEN l.CPK IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT != 0 
      THEN CAST(l.CPK AS REAL) / CAST(l.GPT AS REAL)
      ELSE NULL 
    END AS ratio
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
),
filtered_by_sex AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM lab_with_patient
  WHERE SEX IS NOT NULL AND SEX != '' AND ratio IS NOT NULL
),
sex_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    SEX,
    AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM filtered_by_sex
  GROUP BY SEX
),
first_mean_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS val
  FROM sex_averages
),
above_first AS (
  SELECT sa.avg_ratio
  FROM sex_averages sa
  CROSS JOIN first_mean_val fm
  WHERE sa.avg_ratio > fm.val
),
second_mean_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS val
  FROM above_first
),
above_second AS (
  SELECT af.avg_ratio
  FROM above_first af
  CROSS JOIN second_mean_val sm
  WHERE af.avg_ratio > sm.val
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS final_average,
  AVG(avg_ratio - (SELECT val FROM first_mean_val)) AS avg_excess_over_first,
  AVG(avg_ratio - (SELECT val FROM second_mean_val)) AS avg_excess_over_second
FROM above_second;
